class Base { protected value = 1; }
class Derived extends Base { public value = 2; }
const a: Derived = new Base();
const b: { value: number } = new Derived();
const c: { value: number } = new Base();
class Other { protected value = 3; }
const d: Base = new Other();
const e: Base = { value: 1 };
class Sub extends Base { protected value = 5; }
const f: Base = new Sub();
const g: Sub = new Base();
